description: Final ECS normalization for macOS Endpoint Security Framework events

script.source: if (ctx.process?.executable instanceof Map) { def raw = ctx.process.executable; def path = raw.path; if (ctx.esf == null) ctx.esf = new HashMap(); if (ctx.esf.process == null) ctx.esf.process = new HashMap(); ctx.esf.process.executable = raw; if (path != null) ctx.process.executable = path; else ctx.process.remove('executable'); } if (ctx.user?.id != null) ctx.user.id = ctx.user.id.toString(); if (ctx.event_type != null) { if (ctx.esf == null) ctx.esf = new HashMap(); ctx.esf.event_type = ctx.event_type.toString(); ctx.remove('event_type'); } if (ctx.version != null) { if (ctx.esf == null) ctx.esf = new HashMap(); ctx.esf.version = ctx.version.toString(); ctx.remove('version'); }
